messages:
lee: Follow-up from RFC: discussion on "delegated actor" model vs "token passthrough" for cross-project service calls. Goal: allow services to act on behalf of projects without exploding API key surface. Brief proposal below.

ana: short primer please? I'm fuzzy on practical tradeoffs we agreed on last week.

lee: TL;DR: two options
1) Delegated-actor: broker mints ephemeral actor tokens with explicit project binding and role claims. runtime enforces policies based on actor claim. strong audit trail.
2) Token-passthrough: upstream service passes original API key/token to downstream runtime, which resolves identity via authn service and applies policy. simpler but leaks long-lived creds and increases policy-store lookups.

peter: pros/cons I see: delegated-actor -> better least-privilege, easy revocation, small token TTLs. Con: broker becomes critical path and we add mint step (latency). passthrough -> fewer moving pieces but harder to audit/rotate and we need to extend IAM resolvers everywhere.

lee: exact. My suggested hybrid: allow passthrough within trusted cluster boundaries, but for public/ingress-facing routes require delegated-actor tokens. Also introduce an "actor-forward" header for trusted intra-cluster calls so we preserve calling chain without exposing secrets.

sara: what would "actor-forward" look like? example? :eyes: 

lee: example: 
```
# service A obtains ephemeral delegated token from broker
Authorization: Bearer svc.eph.eyJ...
X-Actor: svc:worker:proj-77
# when A calls B inside cluster, it can forward actor chain (signed by broker)
X-Actor-Forward: eyJhbGciOiJI... (compact signed blob)
```

peter: signing: broker signs actor tokens and actor-chain blobs. edges/nodes only need to verify signature, no external lookup. sign keys -> KMS/HSM, publish JWKS.

ana: revocation and rotation? how do we handle long-lived legacy keys used by customers?

lee: migration plan: 1) broker issues ephemeral mapped tokens for legacy keys on first call (shadow-mode), 2) we emit deprecation warnings in logs and console + provide SDK exchange, 3) automated UI flow to re-issue scoped keys for projects. Revoke path: broker exposes revoke endpoint and we maintain a short revocation window at edge cache.

infra-bot: note: created staging task INF-849: implement actor-forward header validation and local jwk cache :white_check_mark: 

peter: perf notes: validate token signature locally with cached jwks (rare rotation), keep policy cache per-edge shard. Suggested numbers: token lifetime 3m, jwks refresh 30s, policy cache TTL 10s, fallback store read p99 80ms. We should measure end-to-end p95 on our perf rig.

lee: audit: include immutable call chain in logs: origin principal -> broker -> leaf actor. Make sure billing pipeline reads actor-chain to attribute usage to projects and to external integrators separately.

ana: one tricky case: fan-out calls (one request triggers many downstream calls). How do we avoid N extra mint operations?

lee: good catch. options: a) mint a single short-lived token and reuse for fan-out, b) allow forward header to carry signed proof-of-delegation so downstreams trust the forwarded actor without re-mint. Both valid; prefer b for scale. We'll constrain forwarding to trusted subnets.

sara: security concern: what if a compromised service forwards actor chain to an untrusted endpoint? Mitigation: short TTLs, audience checks (token contains intended recipient), and edge-level allowlist for forwarded actor acceptance.

peter: policy modeling: keep schema minimal: {subject, actor_type, project, route_pattern, methods, allow/deny, conditions}. Evaluate at edge with O(1) checks. Avoid complex policy languages for hot path. Complex policies can live in centralized store for offline checks.

lee: next steps: I'll write RFC addendum: token formats (compact JWT), X-Actor and X-Actor-Forward header specs, JWKS rotation plan, migration timeline, canary checklist. @peter can you add perf numbers to the doc? @ana can you own SDK exchange helpers + console UX?

ana: will do. SDK helper will be a one-liner exchange function and automatic refresh. Console: add "Scoped key" creation UX and migration banner for legacy keys.

lee: thanks. Target: draft addendum in 5 days, staging test in 3 weeks. We'll sync with infra & devex. :+1:
